evidence.original_label: 分地区｜中国大陆｜营业收入
evidence.excerpt: columns: 营业收入、营业成本、毛利率（%）、营业收入比上年增减（%）、营业成本比上年增减（%）、毛利率比上年增减（%）; row: 中国大陆; values: 742,283,148.65、457,580,983.39、38.35、13.73、16.81、-1.63
evidence.review_notes: Confirmed on Jingyi Automation FY2023 annual report p28 (pdftotext -layout), table 主营业务分行业、分产品、分地区、分销售模式情况, 分地区 row 中国大陆: 营业收入 742,283,148.65, 营业成本 457,580,983.39, 毛利率 38.35% -- matches exactly, and is correctly distinguished from the adjacent 分产品 rows (半导体专用温控设备/半导体专用工艺废气处理设备/晶圆传片设备/零配件及支持性设备/维护维修等服务) above it, which carry different values. For this entity 分行业(半导体设备)/分地区(中国大陆)/分销售模式(直销) are all numerically identical in every year reviewed, and the company's own narrative states revenue is 100% mainland-China, 100% direct-sales, single-industry. Unlike Piotech, no existing atlas record for Jingyi Automation's main-business total is registered at multi_equipment, so there is no internal precedent conflict here; the 分产品 mix (equipment + 零配件 parts + 维护维修 service revenue) is also broader than a pure equipment-only basket, supporting category_id=all_businesses as the better fit. Accepted as recorded.

notes: Jingyi Automation (京仪装备) FY2023 annual report p28, 『主营业务分地区情况』table, single row 中国大陆. Basis confirmed directly by the issuer's own narrative (主营业务分地区变动说明：公司...中国大陆区域内主营业务收入为...万元), which names the figure as 主营业务收入 explicitly rather than requiring a residual test. No overseas/outside-mainland row is printed in this filing; all three held annual reports (FY2023-FY2025) show this single-row structure. Printed growth-rate cells are visible in the excerpt but are out of this batch's registration scope.
